desc: Gain a Powder. Your strongest Powder's explosion radius is increased by two hexes, has different damage falloff, but deals 50% damage to ALLIES.

name: Trolling
desc: Gain a Trundle. Your strongest Trundle's Ability no longer heals, but grants him 140% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, and permanently grants him 1.5% Attack Damage. His maximum mana is reduced by 50.

name: Adaptive Strikes
desc: Gain a Jax. Your strongest Jax's attacks deal bonus magic damage every 3rd attack which gets stronger each time. His ability grants Attack Speed.

name: Button Mash
desc: Gain a Poppy. Your strongest Poppy's ability is replaced with a 3-hit Wallop.

name: Cease and Desist
desc: Gain a Vi. Your strongest Vi gains Attack Speed and her ability dashes to the farthest target within 3-hexes, Stuns, and deals bonus physical damage.

name: Wolf Unchained
desc: Gain a Sylas. Your strongest Sylas's ability deals more damage and recasts on kill, but his Health gain no longer scales with Ability Power.

name: Nine Thousand Volts
desc: Gain a Kennen. Your strongest Kennen becomes a ranged Marksman. He throws piercing Shurikens that can stun and deal magic damage.

name: Perfect Form
desc: Gain a Zac. Your strongest Zac becomes a Specialist. He now bounces around the battlefield dealing damage in a one hex radius.

name: Schoolyard Justice
desc: Gain a Garen. Your strongest Garen becomes a Fighter. He no longer Heals, but deals more damage and executes weak enemies.

name: Tectonic Titan
desc: Gain a Malphite. Your strongest Malphite becomes a Fighter, gaining increased Attack Speed. He now charges at nearby enemies, knocking them up and dealing heavy damage.

name: Air Axiom
desc: Gain an Air Hex. Champions within gain 25% Attack Speed and their damage 30.0% Sunders enemies for 5 seconds.

name: Artillery Barrage
desc: Gain a Rumble. Your strongest Rumble gains +7 Range and constantly fires missiles at enemies, increased with Attack Speed.

name: Earth Axiom
desc: Gain an Earth Hex. Champions within gain 40 Armor and Magic Resist. At 50% Health, they Stun enemies within 2 hexes for 2 seconds.

name: Fire Axiom
desc: Gain a Fire Hex. Champions within gain 15% Attack Damage and Ability Power. Their damage 0% Burns and 33.0% Wounds for 6 seconds.

name: Hammer of Orlon
desc: Gain an Illaoi. Your strongest Illaoi becomes a Fighter. Her Ability is replaced with an airborne slam that's recast when she kills her target.

name: Leap of Faith
desc: Gain an Illaoi. Your strongest Illaoi becomes a Fighter. Her Ability is replaced with an airborne slam that's recast when she kills her target.

name: Rocket Fist
desc: Gain a Blitzcrank. Your strongest one becomes an Attack Fighter. His Ability no longer shields but instead fires a hook towards the furthest enemy and gains powerful punches for a set amount of attacks.

name: Shadow Dash
desc: Gain a Shen. Your strongest Shen becomes an Attack Fighter. His Ability is replaced with a dash that strikes low Health enemies. The number of dashes increases with each cast.

name: Trials of Twilight
desc: Gain 2 Xin Zhao. Your strongest Xin Zhao constantly strikes nearby enemies and executes enemies. After 2 player combats as a 3-star, unlock Zaahen. He replaces Xin Zhao and takes his items.

name: Trials of Twilight II
desc: Gain 1 Xin Zhao and a Bloodthirster. Xin Zhao becomes an Attack Fighter. After 2 player combats as a 3-star, unlock Zaahen. At the start of the next 2 stages, gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator.

name: Vorpal Spikes
desc: Gain a Cho'Gath. Your strongest Cho'Gath gains +1 Attack Range and his attacks launch spikes that deal magic damage based on his max Health.

name: Water Axiom
desc: Gain a Water Hex. Champions within gain 3 Mana Regen. Their damage 30.0% Shreds enemies for 5 seconds.

name: Wood Axiom
desc: Gain a Wood Hex. Champions within gain 15% max Health. After combat, they permanently gain 55 Health.

name: Bonk!
desc: Gain a Nasus. Your strongest Nasus becomes an Attack Fighter with a single target Ability that gets stronger with each kill.

name: Precise Smithing
desc: Reforging items and Artifacts grants an anvil of the same value instead. Gain 1 component and 2 reforger now, and 1 reforgers every stage. Includes components and Radiant Items, but does not affect Emblems or Tactician's Items.

name: Shieldmaiden
desc: Gain a Leona. Your strongest Leona becomes an Attack Fighter that dashes through enemies to deal physical damage, stunning the first target hit.

name: Stellar Combo
desc: Gain an Aatrox. Your strongest Aatrox becomes an Attack Fighter with an ability that swaps between three different strikes.

name: Termeepnal Velocity
desc: Gain a Poppy. Your strongest Poppy becomes a ranged Attack Caster that flings a high-velocity Meep at her target.

name: Yasuo's Golden Hex
desc: Paint a Golden Hex. The unit in the hex gains 250 health, 25% attack speed, and drops 1 gold on kill.
